BasicNative.description: One of the mod's DLLs, as the Overhaul setup form sets it.
BasicNative.title: BasicNative

Changed.description: A command that wrote the profile: the host's other views read it again, and Undo restores the version before.
Changed.title: Changed

Choices.description: What the player set in the dialog (modules.mods.mod_install.InstallChoices).
Choices.title: Choices

ConfigFileRead.description:
A file as read: the text exactly (line breaks as \n) and what writing it back needs. The client builds the
form from the text (modules.mods.mod_configs.parse_doc).
ConfigFileRead.title: ConfigFileRead

FolderPlan.description: A change to the profile's folder: the counts say how much changes, refusals why a start would be refused.
FolderPlan.title: FolderPlan

LaunchRef.description: The profile as the setup the shell launches: kind "me3" or "manifest" (an overhaul installer's), and its source.
LaunchRef.title: LaunchRef

LayoutNames.description: The four folder names; None leaves one as it is.
LayoutNames.title: LayoutNames

ModConfigsState.description: The page's facts: the profile they were read for ("" when there is none) and its mods with settings files.
ModConfigsState.title: ModConfigsState

ModNode.description:
One mod with settings files. key: stable across reads (seamless, or kind:path); target: what a file is attached
to (a DLL, or a package's folder); loaded: Seamless only: the profile loads it.
ModNode.title: ModNode

ModsPageState.description:
The Mods page for one profile. profile is "" (facts None) when none is picked, the file is not there or there
is no game. rebuild_undo: the newest rebuild's job record that can still be taken back; seamless: "" | "move" |
"cleanup" (Seamless Co-op also in the game folder); rename_code: why the profile can't be renamed or copied
whatever is running (a profile_mods.DELETE_* code), or ""; folders: entry -> its folder's name (where the Rename
dialog starts); closed: the (profile, key) InfoBars the player closed this session.
ModsPageState.title: ModsPageState

OptionsView.description:
What the Mod options dialog shows for one entry. init_kind: 0 none, 1 call a function, 2 wait (ms); overlay:
null when it does not apply, else whether the parameter overlay is set by hand.
OptionsView.title: OptionsView

PageFacts.description:
Everything the Mods page shows about one profile, read from disk at once (run it off the UI thread); the
presenter turns it into rows and words. Indexes are the profile's block indexes.
PageFacts.title: PageFacts

ScalingSpec.description: The difficulty keys one Seamless Co-op flavour uses, their labels, and the presets offered for them.
ScalingSpec.title: ScalingSpec

SettingSpec.description: One setting a client may change: its kind decides which values are allowed, its scope where it is stored.
SettingSpec.title: SettingSpec

SetupForm.description: The overhaul setup form's values (shared with routers/mod_configs).
SetupForm.title: SetupForm

bayle__modules__mods__mods_page__ToolInf.description: A mod's rebuild tool: what the player is asked to allow. key tells that it is another version of the tool.
bayle__modules__mods__mods_page__ToolInf.title: ToolInfo

post.description:
Start taking a job back (its result: {"said": ...}); refusals are OperationError codes
(modules.activity.service).
Errors: not_found (the profile, or the change is not left out now), profile_write_failed.
Errors: not_found, no_game.

get.description: Ordered job events. `id` is the seq, `event` the type. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to continue.

post.description: Make the game current (and the one the next start opens on). Errors: unknown_game, busy.
Ask the job to stop (it ends with a `cancelled` event). Idempotent: a job that is over just reports its state.
What would stop Play now, read fresh from the disk. Error: not_found.
An empty profile for the current game in me3's folder. Errors: invalid_value, create_failed, busy.

Start Play as a job; its result is {"mode"} (offline when the player chose it at the online question). Prompts
(question codes backup_failed, stale_blocked, stale_rebuild, rebuild_failed, online_risk, offline_confirm) go
out as prompt events; the answer key `cancel` ends the job as cancelled. Errors: not_found, cannot_launch
(details.reason game_unsupported | not_installed | game_running | problems), busy.
Remember the profile Play uses next for the current game. Error: not_found.
A job (one Undo in Activity takes back every profile); its result is {"profiles": [names]}.
What setting the mod up as the profile's overhaul would do; nothing is written.

What a friend's shared settings (text) would change; nothing is written. Errors: not_settings,
nothing_to_change (details: unknown).
What turning the profile's overhaul back into an ordinary mod would do; nothing is written.
A job; its result is {"path"}. The file is written whole or not at all.
A job; its result is {"name"}. Errors: stale, cannot_set_up (details: refusals), busy.
The Overhaul setup form's starting state: the choices the mod's files give and the values as the config has them.
Apply the shared settings. Errors: stale, password_empty, not_settings, nothing_to_change, not_saved.

Write a file by its kind. Errors: not_found, stale (it changed since it was read), password_empty, unreadable,
not_saved.

Save the profile's overhaul setup, from the form or as text. Apply it with mod_configs.apply_setup. Errors:
not_found, stale, invalid_setup, invalid_params, not_saved.
A job (one Undo); its result is {"name"}. Errors: stale, cannot_turn_off, busy.
What installing an overhaul from the folder would do. Errors: not_found, unreadable.
What removing the profile's overhaul would do. Errors: not_found, no_overhaul, cannot_remove.
What taking over a setup its own installer made would do. Errors: not_found, no_overhaul, cannot_take_over.
The dialog was cancelled: the unpacked copy is dropped.

A job with one Undo in Activity; its result is {"name", "overhaul", "update"}. The install ends with it.
Errors: unknown_install, stale, cannot_plan, not_ready (details: reason, refusals), busy.

The download ships .me3 profiles: the Export / Import page takes over its unpacked folder (and clears the
staging folder itself), so the install ends without dropping it. Errors: unknown_install, no_profiles.

Unpack and plan a download; it stays open until install_finish, install_close or install_import. Heavy: not for
the UI thread. Errors: not_found, unreadable, not_installable, already_listed.

The overhaul preview and the setup form's rows. Heavy: not for the UI thread. Errors: unknown_install,
not_offered.

Plan again for the typed name, id and variant. Heavy: not for the UI thread. Errors: unknown_install,
cannot_plan (the last good plan stays).
Which of the picked or dropped paths can be installed.
What overhauls' own installers left beside the profile that no profile uses any more.
A job: the chosen leftovers go to the Recycle Bin. Errors: not_found, nothing_chosen, busy.
A job with one Undo in Activity. Errors: not_found, unreadable, stale, cannot_install (details: refusals), busy.
A job with one Undo in Activity. Errors: not_found, no_overhaul, stale, cannot_remove (details: refusals), busy.

For an overhaul its own installer set up: the changes it made that can be put back. Errors: not_found,
no_overhaul.
A job with one Undo in Activity. Errors: not_found, no_overhaul, stale, cannot_take_over (details: refusals), busy.

For Take over: what the player may also choose, the entries the installer copied ticked. Errors: not_found,
no_overhaul, no_takeover.
The shared versions no profile uses. Errors: cannot_tell (message: why), nothing_unused.
What giving the profile its own copy of a Shared mod would do. Errors: not_found, not_shared.
What sharing a Separate package would do; nothing is written. Errors: not_found.
A job with one Undo in Activity. Errors: not_found, not_shared, nothing_chosen, busy.
The other profiles a Shared mod could be linked into. Errors: not_found, not_shared, no_other_profiles.
A job (to the Recycle Bin; Undo in Activity brings them back). Errors: cannot_tell, nothing_unused, stale, busy.

A job with one Undo in Activity. Errors: not_found, not_shared, stale, busy; the job fails with
library_refused.
A job with one Undo in Activity. Errors: not_found, stale, busy; the job fails with library_refused.
Remembered for this version of the tool. Errors: no_tool, stale.
The rebuild tool the profile would run. Errors: no_tool.

What deleting the profile would do (it moves to Deleted profiles; its mod folders stay). Errors: no_profile,
managed (its installer owns it), busy.
What giving each loose DLL mod a folder of its own would do.
What moving a profile outside Bayle's folder into it would do. Errors: profile_blocked.
An entry that only points at a folder of mods: taking it out changes nothing in the game.
What of Seamless Co-op sits in the game folder. Errors: busy, nothing_to_do.
What giving every profile of a crowded folder its own folder would do.
The parse gate of the editor: pure, nothing is read from disk.
Errors: nothing_to_trim (details: keep).
Move the profile to Deleted profiles. A job; its result is {"moved_to"}. Errors: what the check gives, stale.
A job. Errors: cannot_move (details: refusals), stale.
Ship the ordering so a client drags without asking again: the refusal for every drop spot of this entry.

Copy the profile as "<name> copy". A job; its result is {"profile", "name"}. Asks (needs_confirmation, details:
reason "share") only when its packages could be shared and share is null. Errors: profile_blocked.
Put the mod that must stay last back last.
Mods kept as the same Separate copy in several profiles (the disk scan; worked out after the page shows).

Move a profile outside Bayle's folder into it (its Undo is in Activity). A job; its result is {"profile"}.
Errors: profile_blocked, cannot_move_in (details: refusals), stale.
Why the profile can't be renamed or copied now: no profile, run by an installer, a job, the game running.
Reads the profile's folder only.

A job. Errors: rebuild_game_running, rebuild_blocked, nothing_to_rebuild (details: detail), tool_cannot_run,
busy, and needs_confirmation (details: reason "allow_tool", tool) before a rebuild tool that is not allowed yet
runs: answer with allow=True.

A job; its result is {"name", "undo"} (the record undo_removal takes back). Without confirmed it answers
needs_confirmation (details: the facts to ask about) unless Undo brings everything back. Errors: not_found, stale.
A job; its result is {"name"}. Errors: not_found, stale, busy.
A job; its result is {"name", "to"}. Errors: not_found, stale, busy.
Rename the profile's folder to the profile's name (Undo in Activity). Errors: folder_refused.
Whether renaming to the name is allowed and what it would change; nothing is written.

Rename the profile (its Undo is in Activity). A job; its result is {"profile": the new path, "name"}. Errors:
profile_blocked (details: reason), invalid_name (details: code, reason).
Errors: not_found, stale, invalid_wait, options_not_saved.
The profile as the player wrote it (a Version is kept first). Errors: invalid_toml (details: why).

Move Seamless Co-op from the game folder into this profile, or clean up what it left there (the files go to the
Recycle Bin; the profile's own copy and the settings file in use are never touched). A job; its result is
{"kind"}. Errors: busy, nothing_to_do, stale.

One me3 option of the profile, comments kept. Turning online matchmaking on answers needs_confirmation
(details: reason "online") until confirmed=True. Errors: unknown_setting, profile_write_failed.
A job. Errors: cannot_split (details: refusals), stale.
A job; its result is {"moved"}. Errors: nothing_to_trim, stale.
Put back the copy kept just before the last change to the profile.
Answer a question a running job asked (a `prompt` event). Error: unknown_prompt.
Take in backup folders older tools left beside the saves (also a start-up step; Refresh asks for it too).
A job; its result is {"saves", "backups"}.
The backup a removal would delete; the client confirms its stamp.
The name of the copy a removal would take out; the client confirms it.
A job; its result is {"character", "slot", "file", "save", "backup", "undo"}.
One Library copy, for a client to ask about it first (it was changed outside the launcher).
The Saves, Backups or Library folder to show (the last two are created if they do not exist yet).
A job; its result is {"imported": [{"file", "entry_id", "name"}], "failed": [{"file", "code"}]}.
Copy a backup into the Library under a name (the backup stays and ages out as usual); text is the name.
Keep a backup whatever its age, or let it age out again.
A job; its result is {"file", "save", "backup", "undo"}.
A job; its result is {"file", "source", "save", "backup", "undo"}.
A job; its result is {"file", "source", "save", "backup", "undo"}.
A job; its result is {"file", "save", "backup", "undo"}.
A job; its result is {"source", "entry_id", "name"}.
The save's facts; which slot to show is the client's (the Qt page words the sheet itself).
The toast's Undo: put the backup taken before a write back over the save. The job's result is {"file"}.

get.description: The value each setting has in a fresh settings file (for Reset).
